description: This file contains asynchronous functions for managing role competency mappings within a database, using SQLAlchemy. It provides functions to retrieve, list, and create role competency entries, acting as a repository layer in the application.

methods.name: Optional[RoleCompetency] get_role_competency(session: AsyncSession, role_id: str, competency_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a RoleCompetency record for the given role and competency IDs, or None if not found.

methods.name: List[RoleCompetency] list_role_competencies_for_role(session: AsyncSession, role_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all RoleCompetency records associated with a specific role ID.

methods.name: RoleCompetency create_role_competency(session: AsyncSession, payload: RoleCompetencyCreate)
methods.description: Creates and persists a new RoleCompetency mapping, raising an error if a duplicate exists.
